title: EC2 Instance Unable to Access S3
symptom: Application or CLI running on EC2 returns 'Unable to locate credentials' or 'AccessDenied' when running `aws s3 ls s3://my-bucket`.
initial_observations: Command fails when accessing AWS APIs from within the instance.
environment: EC2 instance with or without an attached IAM Instance Profile.

possible_causes.cause: No IAM Instance Profile attached to the EC2 instance
possible_causes.remediation: Attach an IAM role to the instance using `aws ec2 associate-iam-instance-profile`.

possible_causes.cause: Attached IAM role lacks s3:GetObject or s3:ListBucket permissions
possible_causes.evidence_needed: IAM role policy does not grant necessary action on target bucket ARN.
possible_causes.remediation: Update role policy to include required s3 actions on `arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket` and `arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*`.

possible_causes.cause: IMDSv2 hop limit prevents container/SDK token retrieval
possible_causes.evidence_needed: Instance metadata options show HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 with containerized app.
possible_causes.remediation: Increase HttpPutResponseHopLimit to 2 using `aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options`.

investigation_steps.title: Check Attached IAM Instance Profile on EC2 Instance
investigation_steps.explanation: Verify an instance profile is associated with the instance.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Arn and Id of attached instance profile.

investigation_steps.title: Query IMDS Credentials Endpoint From Inside Instance
investigation_steps.explanation: Verify instance metadata service is vending credentials.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Role name returned by metadata service.

investigation_steps.title: Verify Caller Identity and Active IAM Policy
investigation_steps.explanation: Confirm which role credentials the AWS CLI is currently using.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Assumed-role ARN matching expected role name.

verification: Run `aws s3 ls s3://my-bucket` from instance and verify bucket contents list successfully.
prevention: Use IAM roles exclusively for EC2 workloads; never store static IAM access keys on instances.
Apply least-privilege IAM policies scoped to specific bucket ARNs.
